description: Presidential Secretariat - Call out with Effect from 22.04.2024 all the Members of the Armed Forced for the Maintenance of Public Order
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal order issued under the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) by the President, calling out armed forces for maintaining public order. It constitutes a regulatory action based on existing legislation rather than being about government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The content fits Legal/Regulatory as it involves the exercise of statutory powers and the implementation of legal provisions for public security.
